method: Exact original instance IDs/matrices; projected needle triangles with separate original wood side-triangle masks where supplied, vertical tangent plane of selected exterior secondary. 0.5mm diagnostic raster; 50mm longitudinal bands. Not a botanical gate or rendered acceptance.
selection: Pins the original bearing node IDs from /tmp/fn99-pass6-audit2; retains moved shoots even when attached upstream of the sampled structural edge. Original side triangles, excluding end caps, supply wood masks. No isolated mask supplies visual acceptance.
before: pass5 spruce production; pass6 oak-only pilot

wood_projection.method: Original swept surface side triangles on the same selected connected system; end caps excluded; clipped to needle projection bounds.
